WebMCP fixture

Registers two page tools through navigator.modelContext. If the browser has no native implementation, a minimal shim is installed on this page only — enough to exercise list_webmcp_tools / call_webmcp_tool. Which one is in play is reported in #status, so a run always says whether it tested against the real API or the shim.

echo returns its input. add_item has a side effect — it appends to the list below and updates #status — so a test can assert the call really ran in the page rather than trusting the return value.
